From your machine

Run from inside your project. It sends what is on your disk right now — uncommitted changes included, nothing pushed to a git host, no commit required.

This is the fast loop while you are still working something out. The full client reference is in the CLI and SDK guide; what follows is what matters when you are deploying.

Getting toft

Section titled “Getting toft”

Installing it and signing in are on Installing toft.

Which app it deploys to

Section titled “Which app it deploys to”

toft link writes that for you and checks the slug against the install first, so a typo fails at link time rather than at deploy time. --app <slug> overrides it for one invocation.

What gets sent

Section titled “What gets sent”

.gitignore decides. Every .gitignore in the tree, with ! negations honoured, plus .git/info/exclude. .toftignore adds to that; it never replaces it.

toft does not shell out to git, so this works in a plain folder that was never a repository.

Always dropped: .git/, .hg/, .svn/, node_modules/, venv/, .venv/, __pycache__/, *.pyc, .DS_Store.

Dropped only when the tree root has a package.json: dist/, build/, out/, .next/, .nuxt/, .svelte-kit/. That is the right bet for a Node project and the wrong one for a static site — so a [static] root pointing inside one of those wins, and your dist/ ships.

Note

toft deploy does not convert your app. Deploying from your machine to an app created from a git repository does not detach it from that repository or change how it updates.

Watching it

Section titled “Watching it”

toft deploy streams the build log and exits with the deploy’s outcome. If you lose the terminal, toft deploy --watch <deployID> rejoins the same build.

Exit codes are a contract, and the two that matter in CI are different failures: 1 means the platform built your code and the build failed; 3 means your credential was refused.

In a pipeline

Section titled “In a pipeline”

There is no --token flag, on purpose: a secret on a command line lands in your shell history and in the process table. A credential and an address are one statement — TOFT_TOKEN is used only alongside TOFT_URL, and every other combination is refused naming both halves.

Use a deploy key rather than your personal one, so the pipeline does not stop working when you leave.
